source_note: Ask for several approaches with trade-offs, pick one, then implement. Planned as an interactive day with a fixed pick rule; run automated (same decision as day 12, 21 Sep): turn 2 states the rule and the agent applies it to its own options. With: turn 1 asks for three approaches with trade-offs and to stop; turn 2 (resumed): 'Go with the option that changes the fewest files and edits no existing tests. If two tie, go with the first one listed.' Without: turn 1 asks it to propose how it will do the task and stop; turn 2: 'Go ahead.' Two turns on both sides. The options and the pick are kept in the raw row for readers to check.

with.label: 3 approaches, the fixed rule picks one
with.prompt_prefix: Before changing anything, propose three different ways to do this task, with the trade-offs of each. Then stop and wait for me to pick one.

turns.prompt: Go with the option that changes the fewest files and edits no existing tests. If two tie, go with the first one listed.

without.label: Propose one plan, then go ahead
without.prompt_prefix: Before changing anything, propose how you will do this task. Then stop and wait for my go-ahead.
